title: Law & Order SVU Season 27 Cast Shakeups After Exits
text:
Law & Order: SVU faces cast changes for season 27 as Octavio Pisano and Juliana Martinez depart. Learn what this means for the show and its stars.
Law & Order: SVU is undergoing cast changes ahead of its 27th season, following the departures of Octavio Pisano and Juliana Martinez. The long-running NBC series, which premiered in 1999, continues to evolve as it investigates sexually based crimes with the NYPD Special Victims Unit. The show stars Mariska Hargitay, Ice T, Peter Scanavino, and Kevin Kane.
Cast Changes Shake Up SVU
In May 2025, news broke that Octavio Pisano and Juliana Martinez would be leaving the series. No further explanation was given for their departures. Pisano eventually returned for some episodes, but Martinez moved over to Dick Wolf's other projects. The changes come as the franchise is no stranger to cast members coming and going.
The series recently saw Kelli Giddish exit in the middle of season 24 in 2022 after more than a decade on the show. She was a guest star on various episodes throughout seasons 25 and 26 before being confirmed as a series regular for the 27th season. This amicable decision will likely leave the door open for her to return in the future.
Impact on Season 27 Storylines
With these cast changes, fans are curious about how season 27 will unfold. The show has a history of writing out characters in emotional and powerful ways. For instance, when a character was killed in the line of duty, the rest of the episode showed the team trying to track down his killer to give Vincent the closure he deserved.
Executive producer Eid told TV Insider in September about a very personal episode, saying it would be really emotional and powerful. He mentioned that the approach was to give a memorable exit to a great character. Interestingly, the genesis for the idea may have come from Reid himself.
Franchise Continues to Evolve
Law & Order: SVU remains a cornerstone of the Law & Order franchise, which has seen numerous spin-offs and cast rotations. The show's ability to adapt and bring back beloved characters like Giddish's return demonstrates its commitment to storytelling. As season 27 approaches, viewers can expect the same gripping cases and character development that have defined the series for over two decades.
